messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — while prepping qbringup for q6b-int4, I noticed a surge of near-duplicates in the 'ct-edgecase' shard. labeler queue is spiking and sampling rate limits are tripping.
jon: ugh. do we have a dedupe metric snapshot? is it content hash or embed-sim?
maya: looks like a mixture. ~70% hash collisions (same canonized text), ~25% high-similarity embeddings. small fraction are paraphrase variants.
ashley: @maya can you paste the query you ran? I want to iterate on the sampler heuristics.
maya: sure — ran this quick script:
```
python tools/sample_stats.py --cohort ct-edgecase --window 48h --dedupe-threshold 0.92 --report csv
```
jon: ok cool. suggests our dedupe threshold is too loose for q6b int4 on long prompts — duplicates amplify labeler cost and skew golden coverage.
priyanka: labelops-bot just posted queue health: `queue_depth=78, avg_label_time=6.2m, backlog_days=3.2` — we need to triage before golden refresh.
labelops-bot: automated alert: sampling_rate_limiter applied to ct-edgecase at 2024-07-28T14:05Z. Reduction factor: 0.6.
kevin: we should short-term bump dedupe threshold to 0.96 for this shard and route the rest to a low-cost rerun bucket. That buys labeler time.
nashley: Agreed. Also recommend synthetic paraphrase collapse: run a lightweight paraphrase classifier to collapse high-similarity groups before sending to human. simple method: use SBERT cosine > 0.94 && prefix-match heuristics.
maya: plan: 1) set dedupe=0.96 for ct-edgecase sampler; 2) create "paraphrase-rescue" bucket for items removed; 3) run a small golden-item audit on the bucket to ensure we don't drop rare intents. sound good?
jon: sounds good. timeline?
maya: I can patch sampler config now, deploy canary in staging, and roll to prod in ~30m if metrics look good.
nashley: I'll spin up a tiny relabel job for the paraphrase-rescue bucket and flag any items with disagreement > 0.3 for manual review.
priyanka: once canary is healthy, we should update the golden refresh checklist — add a post-dedup sample sanity check and an embedding-drift quickscan.
kevin: +1. Also capture the quant-smoke matrix: we need to ensure dedupe change doesn't change model evaluation rank order. run evaluation harness on both versions before golden commit.
maya: putting TODOs in the PR: sampler change, canary config, relabel job, eval-harness run. I'll ping @labelops and @oncall if deploy trips.
jon: thanks. small ask: add a logging field for the sampler to emit removed_group_size and top2-sim so we can monitor collapse behavior.
maya: good call — adding now.
labelops-bot: note: relabel-job created: `paraphrase-rescue-v1` (30k), priority=low, est throughput 900/day.
nashley: will start the relabel run after canary. will post periodic drift checks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priyanka: after relabel, schedule a micro-golden refresh: pick 200 samples from rescue bucket + 800 baseline to ensure coverage.
kevin: and run quant-smoke across q6b-int4 and float16 baseline, collect BLEU/ROUGE/acceptance-rate deltas.
jon: thanks team. keep threads short — if queue goes >100, escalate to SRE.
maya: will update thread when canary completes or if any issues. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
